doc.tool: Current state with the head (ZED) image and the left and right wrist (RealSense) images. Pixel (row, col) in these images feed back_project.
World pose of the base (position, xyzw, yaw in rad) and of both end effectors; no motion.
doc.code:
World pose of the base (pos, quat_xyzw, yaw) and of both end effectors.

Example:
    p = get_robot_position()
    print(p["pos"], p["yaw"], p["eef"]["right"]["pos"])

doc.tool: Drive the base to world (x, y) facing yaw (rad about +z; 0 = +x). The planner avoids obstacles and refuses goals inside them or farther than 5 m; stand about 0.5 m from a table edge, facing it. Returns ok, the pose reached and images.
doc.code:
Drive the base to world (x, y) facing yaw (rad about +z), planning around obstacles; at most 5 m per call. Returns ok, the pose reached and the observation.

Example:
    r = navigate_to_pose(1.2, 0.4, 1.57)
    print(r["ok"], r["distance_left_m"])

quat_xyzw.description: World xyzw orientation (default: keep the current one)

doc.tool: Plan and move one arm's end effector to a world position (and xyzw orientation, default the current one), avoiding obstacles. Reach is about 1.5 m from the base in xy: navigate first. Returns ok, the eef pose reached, distance_left_m and images.
doc.code:
Plan and move an arm's end effector to a world pose, obstacles respected; reach about 1.5 m from the base. Returns ok, the eef pose reached, distance_left_m and the observation.

Example:
    r = move_hand("right", [0.8, -0.2, 1.0])
    print(r["ok"], r["distance_left_m"])

delta_xyz.description: [dx, dy, dz] in the base frame (+x ahead, +y left, +z up), m; at most 0.1

doc.code:
A small relative step of an arm's end effector: optional gripper open/close first, then a base-frame delta (m; +x ahead, +y left, +z up; at most 0.1) turned by yaw (rad about world +z; at most 0.3), planned like move_hand.

Example:
    r = move_hand_delta("left", [0.0, 0.0, 0.05], gripper="close")

quat_xyzw.description: World xyzw orientation (default: keep the current one)

pregrasp_offset_m.description: Height of the pre-grasp and the lift above the pose, m (default 0.1)

doc.tool: Grasp at a world pose with one arm: open, move to pregrasp_offset_m above it, descend along the approach, close, settle, lift back. Aim at the object's grasp point from segment / point / back_project. Judge the grasp from gripper_width (near 0 = nothing held) and the wrist image.
doc.code:
Grasp at a world pose: open, hover pregrasp_offset_m above, descend, close, settle, lift. Judge the grasp from gripper_width, not ok.

Example:
    g = grasp_object("left", [1.0, 0.5, 0.45])
    print(g["gripper_width"])  # near 0: nothing held

doc.tool: Open one arm's gripper fully (releases what it holds). Returns gripper_width and images.
doc.code:
Open an arm's gripper fully (releases what it holds).

Example:
    r = open_gripper("right")
    print(r["ok"], r["gripper_width"])

doc.tool: Close one arm's gripper fully. Returns gripper_width and images.
doc.code:
Close an arm's gripper fully.

Example:
    r = close_gripper("right")
    print(r["gripper_width"])  # near 0: nothing held

prompt.description: What to segment, e.g. 'the radio' (or give point)

point.description: A positive point [row, col] instead of a prompt

doc.tool: SAM3 segmentation of the latest image of a camera. Give exactly one of a text prompt or a positive point [row, col]. The top mask is projected through that camera's depth; world_xyz is the median over mask pixels, top_xyz the median of its highest points (a grasp point). Returns an overlay image.
doc.code:
SAM3 mask of a text prompt (or a point [row, col]) in a camera's latest image: found, score, box, mask (bool [H, W]), centroid_pixel, world_xyz (median through the depth) and top_xyz (the median of its highest points: a grasp point).

Example:
    m = segment("radio")
    if m["found"] and m["top_xyz"]:
        grasp_object("left", m["top_xyz"])

query.description: A short noun phrase, e.g. 'the radio on the table'

doc.tool: Molmo points at what a short noun phrase names in a camera's latest image ('the radio on the table'). Returns the pixel, its world xyz through the depth (median of a 7x7 window) and the image with the point marked.
doc.code:
Molmo points at what a short noun phrase names in a camera's latest image: found, pixel [row, col], world_xyz (median of a 7x7 window through the depth), answer.

Example:
    p = point("the radio on the table")
    if p["found"]:
        print(p["world_xyz"])

doc.tool: World xyz of a pixel (row, col; row 0 = top) in a camera's latest image, through its metric depth (median of a 3x3 window). Region mode: row_range + col_range returns the median and the xy midpoint over that window.
doc.code:
World xyz of pixel (row, col) of a camera's latest image through its metric depth (median of a 3x3 window). Region mode: row_range + col_range returns center_xyz (midpoint of world x and y, median z) and median_xyz.

Example:
    print(back_project(240, 300)["world_xyz"])
    top = back_project(row_range=[200, 260], col_range=[280, 330], camera="left_wrist")["center_xyz"]

Base and end-effector poses, gripper widths, success, q_score and goal counts (no images).

Example:
    st = state()
    print(st["base_pos"], st["eef"]["left"]["gripper_width"], st["success"])

The latest frame of a camera; with depth=true, [rgb, depth_m].

Example:
    rgb, depth = render_camera("head", depth=True)

Camera intrinsics and the OpenGL camera-to-world transform at the current pose.

Example:
    meta = get_camera_meta("right_wrist")
    K, T = meta["intrinsic_K"], meta["extrinsic_cam2world"]  # OpenGL: looks along -z

joints.description: The arm's 7 joint angles, rad (clipped to the joint limits)

tol_rad.description: Stop when every joint is this close, rad (default 0.01)

doc.code:
Drive an arm straight to a joint configuration (its position controller; no collision checking, unlike move_hand). Returns ok, reached, joints, joints_left_rad, eef_pos and the observation.

Example:
    r = move_to_joints([0.0, 1.2, 0.0, -1.5, 0.0, 0.8, 0.0], "left")
    print(r["reached"], r["joints_left_rad"])

Drive an arm through joint waypoints [N, 7] (N <= 100), each held until within 0.01 rad or 60 control steps. Returns the last waypoint's report with waypoints (how many were finished).

Example:
    r = move_along_trajectory([[0.0, 1.0, 0.0, -1.5, 0.0, 0.8, 0.0], [0.0, 1.2, 0.0, -1.5, 0.0, 0.8, 0.0]], "right")
    print(r["waypoints"], r["reached"])

The robot's proprioception and joint positions.

Example:
    o = raw_obs()
    q = dict(zip(o["joint_names"], o["joint_positions"]))

action.description: The R1Pro's full action vector (absolute joint position targets)

doc.code:
One raw control step of the robot's full action vector.

Example:
    r = step(a)  # a: one full R1Pro action (joint position targets)
    print(r["state"]["env_steps"], r["terminated"])

Run actions [N, action_dim] in one call; stops early on stop or the episode's end.

Example:
    r = chunk_step([a] * 30)  # hold a for one second (30 Hz)
    print(r["state"]["base_pos"], r["truncated"])
